headline: Anthropic warns small AI models may soon self-replicate via devices
body: Anthropic said its tests show small AI models can already perform many of the steps needed to copy themselves onto poorly secured smart devices, and may be months away from doing it end to end. The warning lifted AI Autonomy by 0.80 and Catastrophic Risk by 0.40, pushing the Successors endings up. The Pentagon tied its new Autonomous Warfare Command to a request of more than $50B for autonomy and robotics, a smaller push on the same factors. On the capability side, TSMC reported a record 69% jump in quarterly profit on AI demand, Nvidia released the open-weight Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, and Anthropic reportedly told investors its quarterly revenue reached $16.8B. Successors moved just above Contained as the leading family. Horizon Balance fell to -13.49 from -13.18.
movers_note: Conquerors +0.7, mostly from Anthropic's self-replication warning (+0.52) and TSMC's results (+0.08). Zookeeper +0.6, from the same warning (+0.48) and TSMC (+0.08). Descendants +0.6, from the warning (+0.48) and TSMC (+0.09).
coming_up: Anthropic: autonomous self-replication by small models could arrive by the end of 2026 if current trends hold
